mechanism: Armodafinil induces CYP3A4, reducing diltiazem metabolism and increasing diltiazem levels, while diltiazem may inhibit armodafinil metabolism via CYP3A4, creating bidirectional enzyme interaction.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and signs of diltiazem toxicity; consider diltiazem dose reduction or alternative wakefulness agent; increased therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted.
